newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - UPM Q1 profit FIM 1.35 bln.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - UPM Q1 profit FIM 1.35 bln.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 1.35 billion markka median forecast for Finnish forestry group UPM-Kymmene Oy's first quarter 1997 profit before extraordinary items and tax:
(Profit forecasts by 17 analysts, EPS by 11 analysts).

Analysts' forecasts include a 700 million markka one-off extraordinary gain of 700 million markka from UPM-Kymmene's sale of two mills. UPM-Kymmene has said it will book the 700 million markka as profit before extraordinary items.
UPM-Kymmene's results are due on May 15 at 0800/0500 GMT.
In January-April 1996, UPM-Kymmene had a 1,648 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
In March, UPM-Kymmene said it expected a steady performance this year.
The median of 11 forecasts for UPM-Kymmene's full-year 1997 profit before extraordinary items and tax was 4,145 million markka (mean 3,993 million), and the range was 3,242-4,850 million markka.
UPM-Kymmene's full-year 1996 profit was 3,555 million markka.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Den Danske Bank, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities, Morgan Stanley, Opstock, Postipankki and Williams de Broe. --Helsinki Newsroom +358-9-680 50 292
